card.name: Headline ends, article text begins
card.fires_on: The break right after a news headline or title, where the body text starts, and a few words inside headlines. It is seen in general web news, not drug labels.

modes.label: Gap after headline
modes.description: The blank space between a headline and the first line of the article.
modes.example: New York Passes Sewage Pollution Right-to-Know Act<< >>On August 9th, New York

modes.label: Inside headline words
modes.description: A word or word part within a headline, such as 'of', 'In' or 'Sh'.
modes.example: Alcohol Awareness Month<< Sh>>eds Light on US Drinking The purpose

card.plain: It marks the point where a news headline ends and the story begins, or a word inside a headline.
